name: Orbfall
storyline: After the alien invasion, the last survivors of humanity continue to fight. As they try to rebuild civilization, they face overwhelmingly powerful aliens that now rule Earth. Thanks to Orb technology, humanity has one final chance to strike back.
summary: Orbfall - Reclaim the Planet is an upcoming action-packed sci-fi adventure currently in beta development. It is set in a shattered world devastated by the impact of mysterious orbital objects, players explore dangerous environments, gather resources, battle hostile alien factions, and fight to reclaim the planet from chaos. Featuring detailed base building, team-based PvE combat across multiple maps, and a dark atmospheric setting, Orbfall delivers an immersive blend of survival, exploration, and intense futuristic warfare as humanity struggles to rebuild its future. (Still in development though)
